title: Population Genetics
description: Evolution is bookkeeping on genes: a better one spreads, a worse one fades, and chance can lose either. Unlocks the Selection Chamber.

puzzle.goal: Two alleles are at frequencies p and q = 1 - p. Write the share H of the population carrying one of each (Hardy-Weinberg heterozygotes), as two p q.
puzzle.name: Mixed carriers
puzzle.ask: Find H for p = @{p} and q = 0.4.
puzzle.method: Two ways to inherit one of each (p then q, or q then p), so 2pq; the homozygotes are p^2 and q^2.
